reviews.title: Connection issy
reviews.text: This is possibly one of the worst apps I have ever subscribed to. When watching a video it will stop playing, loads for hours and brings up a message that says there is a network issue. When I try switching to my mobile data it does the same thing. Problem is, it only does this to the dramas that I would be currently watching at that time, if I click on a different one, it plays. I had just recently subscribed to their svip membership so I could get early access but it wont even play the videos. I tried giving feedback through the app but it gives me a generic answer written by ai, to just restart which I had done countless times. I tried getting in contact with the team, the email doesn’t exist and the facebook page no longer exists. It’s not worth it, any other app is better than this.

reviews.title: 看廣告賺積分之問題
reviews.text:
1. 本來看廣告積分獲得挺快的，現在更新之後每次看廣告都只有獲得10積分，有些甚至看了100多秒的廣告也是10積分，明顯遊戲規則被改得非常不公平，而且還浪費用戶電力、流量。

2. 然後廣告看完的時候打叉叉又設計的很小，非常難點，有時候按了叉叉還會另外再跳出廣告，非常煩人，故意設計造成用戶誤點到。

3. 觀看廣告時也會出現偷秒數的問題，計算時間與實際時間不同。

其實種種問題本質上跟詐騙沒兩樣，加上騰訊公司在台灣沒有設立公司，也無從反應及維權，台灣地區用戶在使用時不管是付費、還是看廣告的方式請評估風險後再時用。

reviews.title: Poor user experience
reviews.text:
The WE TV app is extremely unuser-friendly, slow and frustrating to use.

The viewing experience is particularly poor. You’re forced to watch in a small screen, and I absolutely hate the way the app keeps switching between vertical and landscape mode. It’s distracting and makes watching anything feel unnecessarily difficult.

The constant adverts are incredibly annoying, especially considering I’m paying for the VIP version. You would expect a much better, more streamlined experience when paying for a subscription, yet there are still adverts everywhere. Even when you open a programme to find out more about it, you’re confronted with endless adverts underneath.

The download experience is also extremely poor. Downloading programmes is slow and unreliable, and trying to go back and rewatch downloaded content is just as frustrating. There are endless bugs, glitches and periods of slowness, which completely ruins the experience.

For a paid VIP service, this app is nowhere near the standard it should be. It feels poorly designed, unnecessarily complicated and far too slow. The app desperately needs a serious overhaul to fix the bugs, improve performance and make watching content straightforward.

At the moment, using WE TV feels like a chore rather than an enjoyable streaming experience.

reviews.text:
WeTV needs some improvements.
The home page does not automatically rotate based on the device orientation, and the video player cannot be minimized when exiting the app to quickly check something else on the phone. It would be great if WeTV could learn from iQIYI. On top of that, there are not many dramas that match my preferences. Even though I subscribed to VIP, I often spend a long time searching before finding something I want to watch. Some dramas are only available with foreign dubbing, which is the most annoying part and really affects the viewing experience.
